title: 非數列副線第二題：Tuza 三角形猜想 τ ≤ 2ν 的小範圍 SAT 驗證加 DRAT 證書（n ≤ 9）

TUZA-n<=9.proof: No graph on n <= 9 vertices has tau > 2 nu: for every k = 1..kmax(n) the CEGAR SAT formula (nu <= k and tau >= 2k+1) is UNSAT; every blocking clause's witness and the CaDiCaL DRAT proof were checked by discovery/tuzasat/check.py (own RUP checker), each run within config/limits.json. n = 10: k = 1..3 certified; k = 4..10 solver-only UNSAT (certificate checks exceed 600 s, DRAT > 50 MB); n = 10 not claimed.

TOOL-symmetry.proof: Base clauses (TRI, INT, LEX) cover every isomorphism class of graphs whose edges all lie in triangles for n = 4..6 (networkx atlas comparison, tests/test_tuzasat.py).

novelty.note: No published exhaustive small-graph verification of Tuza's conjecture was found, but brute force over all graphs on <= 9-10 vertices is routine and has very likely been done unpublished (e.g. Gupta 2026 checks all labelled 7-vertex graphs as a lemma). Nothing new is claimed.
